## 主张 Claim

剩余程序与到达条件的共同展开有精确完成／接续对应及原生路径投影。共同语法、原生完整同测与接收侧有限分支恢复每个部分历史的余项和到达答案。插入活动后可接实际后段为一条历史，但插入可使原待用接续失效；同一起点产生的余项差异可迫使任何精确说明区分。 / Joint unfolding of residual programs and reached conditions has exact completion/resumption correspondence and native trace projection. Common syntax, complete native-answer agreement and receiving-side finite branching recover residuals and answers along every partial history. Inserted activity and a current-position suffix join into one trace, but insertion can disable a pending continuation; residual differences reached from one start can force distinctions in every exact account.

Carrying out a recipe part of the way leaves a recipe remaining where the course stands (Recipe.Leaves), and this bookkeeping is an unfolding of its own that adds no move (Recipe.Leaves.trace); resuming what remains completes the recipe, and carrying it out to the end is a partial course leaving nothing (Recipe.Leaves.resume, Recipe.leads_iff_leaves). Partial courses from alike configurations match, keeping what remains, with no premise (Recipe.Leaves.alike); from configurations passing the same tests they need listed outcomes and em (Recipe.Leaves.same_of_em). Inserted moves join a partial course and its resumption into one course without being part of the recipe (Recipe.Leaves.inserted). The witness Midway: testing where the course has arrived and testing at the start give different results; one start leaves different remainders at one configuration, which every description exact for resumption keeps apart; an inserted move can disable what remains (Midway.testing_before_formation_changes_results, Midway.remainder_codes_apart, Midway.inserted_can_disable_resumption). The periphery’s ExplanatoryGranularityBoundary.unfolding is defined by a match with an overlapping wildcard case and compiles through propext, so the witnesses of ExplanatoryResumptionCases are restated on the core’s Midway frame (the same six configurations, three moves and six steps). In the bridge, the periphery’s advances and the core’s correspond one to one (Recipe.advance_ofProgram, Recipe.Advance.toProgram), and a cut is a partial course leaving the same program (cut_iff_leaves); cut_resume, execution_iff_completed_cut and resumption_after_inserted_history hold as stated, partial_history_matches with em; same_preserves_resumption needs no premise (the periphery reads each continuation question as one test, classically; the core as finitely many). Empty axiom reports (scratch build; the receipt comes with the landing). The periphery proofs and their receipts keep their scope.
